drawings.description: un carré encadré : $u$ — $uv$ en haut, $1$ — $v$ en bas, avec deux diagonales parallèles $1$–$u$ et $v$–$uv$.
drawings.kind: framed square with two parallel diagonals
drawings.notes: In a drawn frame: u (top left) - uv (top right), 1 (bottom left) - v (bottom right); short strokes for the sides u-uv and 1-v and the two parallel diagonals 1-u and v-uv. The vertical sides are not drawn.

drawings.description: un triangle ; puis un pentagone de sommets reliés à un centre (l'étoile d'un sommet de l'icosaèdre), une face marquée $\alpha$.
drawings.kind: triangle; star of a vertex (pentagon joined to its centre)
drawings.notes: Above: a triangle, pencil strokes doubled. Below: a pentagon with its five vertices joined to a centre (the star of a vertex of the icosahedron), two edges inked heavier; the face marked alpha is the upper one (the letter is small and overinked).

drawings.description: dans le plan, les vecteurs $e_1$, $e_2$, $e_3 = e_1 + e_2$ (diagonale du carré) et $e_4 = e_1 + \lambda e_2$.
drawings.kind: vectors in the plane
drawings.notes: From the origin (bottom left): e_1 (right), e_2 (up), the square on them with the diagonal e_3 = e_1 + e_2, and the longer vector e_4 = e_1 + lambda e_2. The right side of the square is faint (pencil).

drawings.description: à gauche de l'énoncé, l'étoile pentagonale d'un sommet $u_0$, avec une arête épaissie vers $u_1$.
drawings.kind: star of a vertex (pentagon)
drawings.notes: Pentagonal star of u_0: five spokes and the pentagon. Two spokes are thickened, towards the top right vertex and towards the right vertex labelled u_1 (the transcription names one thickened edge, towards u_1).

drawings.description: l'étoile du sommet $u$ : un pentagone $v_0, v_1, \ldots, v_{-1} = v_4$, une flèche de rotation au centre.
drawings.kind: star of a vertex with rotation arrow
drawings.notes: Star of u: v_1 (top), v_0 (right), v_{-1} = v_4 (bottom right) are inked, the sides u-v_1, v_1-v_0 thick; on the left the vertices v_2, v_3 are only faint pencil strokes (the pentagon is not closed there); a small rotation arrow at the centre. Strokes from v_3 down towards a point t and the matrix (alpha alpha' / beta 0) at the top left are not drawn. Labels v_2, v_3 after the transcription.

drawings.description: un réseau de faces de l'icosaèdre autour de $u$ et $u_0$, sommets marqués $v_1$, $v_3'$, $v_4'$, $v_2$, $v_6'$, $v_3$, $v_4$, $v_2'$, $v_1'$ ; une face hachurée.
drawings.kind: net of icosahedron faces around two vertices
drawings.notes: Faces of the icosahedron around u (centre) and u_0 (top): the upper triangles A-B-C and A-D-C with heavy edges, the left face; below, the fan of triangles around the centre and the bottom vertex. The hatched face is the triangle u_0 - centre - right vertex. The vertex labels are placed as read on the crop (v'_4, v'_3, v_1, v_2, v'_6, v'_2, v_3, v_4, v'_1); the lower edges are a schematic reading of overlapping strokes.

drawings.description: En marge gauche, un triangle : sommets $V_h$ (en haut), $V_i$ et $V_j$ (en bas) ; côtés marqués $G_j$ (à gauche), $G_i$ (à droite), $G_k$ (en bas).
drawings.kind: triangle with labelled vertices and sides
drawings.notes: Triangle V_h (top), V_i (bottom left), V_j (bottom right); sides G_j (left), G_i (right), G_k (bottom). The vertices are open (strokes stop short of them); small letters h and i mark the corners.

drawings.description: un carré dont les sommets sont joints par les deux diagonales en pointillé, marqué $Q_1$ et $Q_2$, avec une flèche vers $Q_1$ ; à côté : « On a le troisième coin »
drawings.kind: square with dotted diagonals
drawings.notes: Square (sides inked heavily) with its two diagonals dotted and dotted inner lines; Q_2 inside, an arrow from the upper left to Q_1. The words "On a le troisieme coin" beside it are text, not drawn.

drawings.description: un pentagone avec son étoile de diagonales intérieures, en marge
drawings.kind: pentagon with interior strokes
drawings.notes: Pentagon (left side doubled), with a tail stroke from the bottom left corner. Inside there are only short broken strokes, not full diagonals: they are drawn as such. The "star of diagonals" of the transcription is a reading of these fragments.

drawings.description: un losange formé de deux triangles ayant l'arête $a$ en commun, avec une flèche courbe au-dessus : « carré $Q_{\mathcal I}$ »
drawings.kind: rhombus of two triangles with a curved arrow
drawings.notes: Two triangles sharing the horizontal edge a (thick), drawn heavily; a curved arrow over the top vertex. The edge label a and the caption "carre Q_I" are written beside it ("Car..." to the right); a is placed on the shared edge after the transcription.

drawings.description: petit schéma reliant par des traits les mots de trois lettres $yzt$, $ztx$, $xyz$, $txy$ apparus dans les trois expressions.
drawings.kind: brackets linking words in a formula
drawings.notes: Under delta(yzt) and delta(ztx) in the first line of p. 75, two bracket strokes, and below them a scribbled line reading "Rel ... delta(yzt), delta(ztx), delta(tx)". The schema linking yzt, ztx, xyz, txy is at most these brackets and the line under them; nothing else on the page joins the words. The formula itself is text and not drawn.

drawings.description: à droite, un parallélépipède en perspective : sommets marqués par des cercles, certaines arêtes renforcées à l'encre brune, d'autres en pointillé, flèches de rotation autour de deux axes ; étiquettes « $t\ldots$ », « $c$ ». À côté : « $\Sigma_a, \Pi_a$ ». Au-dessus, un petit losange et une flèche circulaire.
drawings.kind: parallelepiped in perspective with rotation arrows
drawings.notes: Parallelepiped: two vertices ringed (top and bottom), the left edge and two front edges heavy, hidden edges dotted; two curved rotation arrows on the faces; "t..." at the top right corner. Above: a small rhombus and a circular arrow. The labels c and Sigma_a, Pi_a are not in the crop (Sigma_a, Pi_a stands lower right); the brown ink of the transcription cannot be told on a grey render.

drawings.description: un petit carré aux sommets numérotés $1, 2, 3, 4$ ; à côté : « $F(x, \underline{y, z}, t)$ ».
drawings.kind: small square with numbered vertices
drawings.notes: Square with vertices 1 (bottom left), 2 (bottom right), 3 (top right), 4 (top left); bottom side heavy. "F(x, y, z, t)" beside it is text.

drawings.description: cube en perspective, avec arêtes renforcées ($a$, $\bar a$, $\bar a'$), sommets cerclés, diagonales, flèches de rotation et étiquettes $f$, $f'$, $f''$.
drawings.kind: cube with reinforced edges, diagonals and rotation arrows
drawings.notes: Cube: the left front edge (a-bar') and the top right edge (a-bar) heavy, the edge to the ringed top back vertex dotted with ticks; two vertices ringed, two heavy dots; face diagonals in two faces; curved rotation arrows; f'' written in the front face. f, f' are not legible on the crop. Which vertex is hidden is a reading.

drawings.description: second cube, arêtes $b$, $b'$ renforcées, faces $f$, $f'$, étiquettes $t''$, $a'$.
drawings.kind: cube with reinforced edges
drawings.notes: Second cube: the top right edge (b) and the bottom front edge (b') heavy, the bottom right edge dotted, two inner strokes. Labels b, f, f' legible near the strokes; t'' and a' are not legible on the crop (small, overwritten) and are left out.

drawings.description: troisième cube, arêtes étiquetées $\Sigma_1$, $\Sigma_2$, $\Sigma_3$.
drawings.kind: cube with labelled edges
drawings.notes: Third cube: Sigma_1 on the heavy left front edge, Sigma_2 on an inner diagonal stroke, Sigma_3 on an arrow under the bottom edge; the top right edge heavy (with a second label read as Sigma_2), the edge to the back top left dotted.

drawings.description: Un cube en perspective. Sommets nommés $A$, $B'$, $C'$, $A'$, $B$, $C$ ; deux sommets opposés marqués d'un point plein. Arêtes nommées $a$ (verticale issue de $A$), $b$, $c$, $a'$, $b'$, $c'$ ; les arêtes $AB'$, $C'$–(sommet marqué) et $a$ sont repassées en trait gras ; un « $W$ » est écrit près de $B$.
drawings.kind: cube with named vertices and edges
drawings.notes: Cube A, B', C', A', B, C and two unnamed vertices (P bottom left front, Q top right back, both marked with a full point; the names P, Q are ours). Edges a (vertical from A), b, c, a', b', c'; AB', C'Q and a heavy; W near B. A blot at the corner by B'. Encoded as polyhedron/1 (V 8, E 12, F 6).

checks.name: cube A B' C' A' B C

drawings.description: Petit cube au crayon, sur lequel trois arêtes deux à deux non coplanaires $\underline{a}$, $\underline{b}$, $\underline{c}$ sont repassées à l'encre, formant une ligne brisée.
drawings.kind: pencil cube with three skew edges inked
drawings.notes: Small pencil cube (approximate: faint, doubled strokes), on which three pairwise non-coplanar edges a (vertical left), c (bottom middle) and b (top right) are inked, forming a broken line.

drawings.description: Un cube en perspective ; trois sommets marqués $s_1$, $s_2$, $s_3$ autour d'un sommet $s$ cerclé ; chaque face visible porte une petite flèche circulaire (orientation).
drawings.kind: cube with oriented faces
drawings.notes: Cube; the vertex s (front top right) circled, s_1, s_2, s_3 around it (s_1 back top right, s_2 front top left, s_3 front bottom right); a small circular arrow on each visible face. Hidden edges faint.

drawings.description: Petit cube : la face $f$ de sommets $s, t, s', t'$ et la face $f'$ de sommets $t, s, t'', s''$, adjacentes le long de l'arête $a$ entre $s$ et $t$ ; arêtes $a'$, $a''$ marquées, ainsi que la diagonale $i$.
drawings.kind: small cube with two adjacent faces
drawings.notes: Small cube, heavily inked at the top right: face f = s, t, t', s' (top) and face f' = t, s, s'', t'' (right), adjacent along the edge a = st (heavy, overinked). Labels t', s', t'', a'', s'' and f, f' (written above) are legible; s, t, a, a' and the diagonal i are placed after the transcription (the corner is a blot). The bottom back edges are faint.

drawings.description: Deux cubes en perspective. Sur le petit, en haut à gauche, les arêtes portent $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, $a'$, $b'$ et, en dessous, $a+\alpha$, $b+\alpha$, $c+\alpha$, $d+\alpha$. Sur le grand, les arêtes portent, cerclées, $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, $u$, et $a+\alpha = a'$ (cerclé $a'$), puis $b+\alpha$, $c+\alpha$, $d+\alpha$, $u+c-a$ ; sur une face : $v = u - (d-b)$ (signe surchargé).
drawings.kind: two cubes with edge labels
drawings.notes: Small cube at the top left with edge labels a, b, c, d, a', b' and below a+alpha, b+alpha, c+alpha, d+alpha (tiny, placed by position); large cube with circled labels a, b, c, d, u, a' and the labels b+alpha, d+alpha, c+alpha, u+c-a, v = u-(d-b) (sign overwritten) and v+(c-a) = u at the right. Hidden edges of both cubes thin. Positions of the small labels approximate.

drawings.description: Un cube en perspective, sommets $A$, $B'$, $C$, $B$, $A'$ nommés, un sommet marqué d'un point plein à l'origine des arêtes $a$, $b$, $c$, un autre sommet marqué d'un point. Arêtes nommées $a$, $b$, $c$, $a'$, $b'$, $c'$, $\alpha$, $\alpha'$, $\beta$, $\beta'$, $\gamma$, $\gamma'$ ; l'arête $\beta$ ($AB'$) est doublée ; un petit arc près du sommet marqué.
drawings.kind: cube with named vertices and edges
drawings.notes: Cube with vertices A, B', C (read C' on the crop, by the front top right), B, A'; a full point at the origin O of the edges a, b, c (front top left) and at the opposite vertex M (back bottom right); the names O, M, X are ours. Edges a, b, c, a', b', c', alpha, alpha', beta, beta', gamma, gamma'; beta = AB' doubled; a small arc near O; the hidden edges (from X) dashed. Encoded as polyhedron/1 (V 8, E 12, F 6).
drawings.disagreement: the vertex the transcription calls C reads C' on the crop

drawings.description: Trois petits segments verticaux parallèles et un quatrième oblique, figurant les directions d'arêtes.
drawings.kind: four short segments (edge directions)
drawings.notes: Three short near-vertical parallel segments and a fourth, longer, oblique one.
